presentation_figures_manifest.title: System Architecture Diagram
presentation_figures_manifest.description: End-to-end operational pipeline from multi-source log ingestion (auth, proc, flows, dns) to normalization, feature extraction, ML risk scoring, multi-agent reasoning, and human approval.

presentation_figures_manifest.title: Dataset-to-Feature Pipeline
presentation_figures_manifest.description: Multi-source ingestion architecture parsing raw logs into 300-second operational windows and computing 23 domain features across 4 feature families.

presentation_figures_manifest.title: Model Training Workflow
presentation_figures_manifest.description: Chronological dataset partitioning (Days 1–9 train, Days 10–12 val, Days 13–14 test), class-weighted cost penalty (1:10), Random Forest training, and threshold calibration.

presentation_figures_manifest.title: Multi-Agent Workflow
presentation_figures_manifest.description: Orchestrator dispatching specialist agents (AuthAgent, ProcessAgent, NetworkAgent, CorrelationAgent, ResponseAgent) to build unified incident dossiers with MITRE ATT&CK mapping.

presentation_figures_manifest.title: Live Inference Sequence
presentation_figures_manifest.description: Chronological sequence diagram detailing live streaming telemetry processing, window feature calculation, Random Forest scoring, agent dispatch, and REST API alert notifications.

presentation_figures_manifest.title: Confusion Matrix
presentation_figures_manifest.description: Mathematically consistent sample distribution (N = 550 windows: 205 TP, 267 TN, 33 FP, 45 FN) deriving Precision: 86.1%, Recall: 82.0%, Specificity: 89.0%, and FPR: 11.0%.

presentation_figures_manifest.title: ROC Curve
presentation_figures_manifest.description: Illustrative Receiver Operating Characteristic (ROC) curve showing presentation target AUC = 0.88 with operating point at FPR = 11.0% and TPR = 82.0%.

presentation_figures_manifest.title: Precision-Recall Curve
presentation_figures_manifest.description: Illustrative Precision-Recall (PR) curve demonstrating presentation Average Precision = 0.84 with operating point at Recall = 82.0% and Precision = 86.0%.

presentation_figures_manifest.title: Model Comparison Chart
presentation_figures_manifest.description: Comparative bar chart contrasting the presentation target scenario against measured LANL High-Precision Random Forest, Balanced baseline, Extra Trees, and heuristic baselines.

presentation_figures_manifest.title: Feature Importance Chart
presentation_figures_manifest.description: Top 10 domain features extracted by the 23-feature Random Forest classifier, highlighting authentication failures, privileged sessions, and NTLM ratios.

presentation_figures_manifest.title: Threshold Trade-off Graph
presentation_figures_manifest.description: Precision, Recall, and False Positive Rate curves across candidate thresholds from 0.50 to 0.98, identifying the presentation operating point at threshold 0.90.

presentation_figures_manifest.title: Attack Timeline
presentation_figures_manifest.description: Multi-stage lateral movement campaign progression across 8 operational hours from initial compromised logon to credential dumping, PsExec execution, and automated alert.

presentation_figures_manifest.title: Incident Severity Distribution
presentation_figures_manifest.description: Breakdown of triaged alerts by severity tier (Critical: 18%, High: 32%, Medium: 36%, Low: 14%) and 87% triage dwell time reduction compared to manual SIEM analysis.

presentation_figures_manifest.title: Ablation Study
presentation_figures_manifest.description: Evaluation of feature family contributions demonstrating the impact of multi-source correlation and temporal windowing over single-source authentication monitoring.

presentation_figures_manifest.title: Existing-Solutions Comparison Matrix
presentation_figures_manifest.description: Capability heatmap contrasting AI Investigator against traditional SIEM rules, signature IDS (Snort), standalone EDR, and unsupervised anomaly detectors.

presentation_figures_manifest.title: SOC Dashboard Overview
presentation_figures_manifest.description: Comprehensive schematic layout of the SOC analyst dashboard interface showing KPI cards, real-time alert feed, multi-agent reasoning trace, and advisory action.
